title: 第零章 弥罗界之变第一章 秦家村第二章 秘洞
content_zh:
广袤无垠的群山之中，除了瑟瑟山风，光秃岩石，并无丝毫入目之物。
“轰隆隆~~~“
突然，一阵震耳欲聋的轰鸣之音自远处天地相接之处滚滚而来。
巨大声音响彻天地，随着此雷鸣之音，一道金光仿若一道金色闪电，风驰电掣一般激射而至。
在金色闪电后千里之处，一片血海奔腾翻滚，席卷向前，其速度奇快无比，并不比前方金色闪电落后丝毫。
红色血海广大之极，面积足有万里之遥。
虽血海还未迫近，但一股血腥之气已然席卷四方。
在鲜红血海之中，数以千万计的骷髅白骨在血海之中若隐若现，显得诡异以极。
在红色血海中央之地，有一个高约千丈的高大祭台耸立中央。
高大祭台隐身在一层红色光幕之内，显得神秘以极。
“哈哈哈，夏侯综英，你身受我师兄的万悲掌力一击，未能立即就陨落，还能逃出如此之远，想来已到了油尽灯枯之际。
老夫劝你还是乖乖束手的好。
看在往日情分之上，星祖说不定能放你一条生路。”
陡然，一声震动天地的巨吼之音自血海深处的那高大祭台之中隆隆传出。
此声音浑长悠远，未用任何传音之术，仅凭深厚法力传出。
千里之外正自激射而逃的金光之中，此时正有一名面色苍白的中年人站立。
此人面色已然没有丝毫血色，双目阴沉以极，下唇因牙齿咬合，已然渗出了滴滴鲜血。
但他并未有丝毫察觉。
此时他正强自压制体内反噬之力，极力催动循光奔逃。
听闻身后传来的劝说之言，此名中年人并未有丝毫异样。

这次趁九幽宫星祖外出，此中年人冒险出手，将九幽宫中的两件异宝偷出，不想却被巡视而来的九幽宫巡察使碰到。
难以圆说情由之下，被迫与数名同阶争斗一起，虽依仗秘术，硬是自防御森严的九幽宫中逃离，但还是被九幽宫的颜师兄击伤。
此时更是被一直追杀到了此地。
如在其全盛之时，后面追杀的此名同阶存在，中年人自是不放在心上，但此时他已然身受重伤，再难以是其对手。
“夏侯综英，只要你交出那两件异宝，老夫却是保证，定然会向星祖老人家求情，免你一死，让你在万幽山下镇压万年。
否则，有什么后果，老夫自是不用言明了。”
见前方之人未有丝毫停下之意，无边血海之中，突然又传出一句劝说之言。
就在此言刚刚传出，前方金色闪电陡然间一敛，白衣中年人突然在空中跌跌撞撞的急速奔出，急抢数步之后，身躯摇晃下，停在了万丈高空之中。
此时他面容狰狞无比，牙齿因为用力咬合，深深的陷入了下唇的血肉之中，脖颈之处更是青筋暴露。
苍白的面容之上，此时却是有一丝潮红显现。
白衣中年人仿佛受伤极重，但其双目之中，却有着一丝疯狂之意闪现。
就在白衣中年人停下之时，无边血海在隆隆的咆哮声中，也已然逼近到了千丈之外。
翻滚不断的血色海水犹如遇到了一睹无形之墙，嘎然而止，不再前行分毫。
“哈哈哈，夏侯综英，看来你的伤势已然难以压制了，是让老夫动手，还是你主动交出那两件异宝？如果老夫亲自出手，你将难有丝毫存活可能，此你要想清楚为好。”
随着声震旷野的巨大声音传出，高大祭台在血海中央一闪，高达千丈的祭台陡然失去了踪影，消失在了无边血海之中。
仅仅转瞬之间，血海边缘之处红芒一闪，高大祭台重新闪现而出。
一名青年模样的修士青芒闪烁间，出现在祭台之上。
这青年面带一丝笑容，正自双目炯炯注视着前方千丈之外的白衣中年人。
“哼，让老夫交出异宝，真是痴心妄想，想此两件宝物，本是我怜妹之物，却被九幽宫强取豪夺了去。
最后连性命也未留下，老夫虽不能为怜妹报此血仇，但将其最为中意之物取出，也算对怜妹有了交代。”

白衣中年人冷哼一声，双目冰冷的沉声说道。
语气之中，对那九幽宫却憎恨以极。
“呵呵，就算你盗出，以你此时状态，难道还有能力将此两物保全不成？”
content_en:
In the vast expanse of mountains, apart from the rustling mountain wind and bare rocks, there is nothing that catches the eye.
"Rumble~~~"
Suddenly, a deafening roar came from where the sky and the earth met in the distance.
A huge sound resounded throughout the world, and following the sound of thunder, a golden light shot out like a golden lightning bolt.
Thousands of miles behind the golden lightning, a sea of ​​blood surged and rolled forward, its speed was extremely fast, not lagging behind the golden lightning in front.
The red sea of ​​blood is extremely vast, covering an area of ​​thousands of miles.
Although the sea of ​​​​blood is not yet approaching, a bloody aura has already swept across all directions.
In the sea of ​​bright red blood, tens of millions of skeletons and bones loomed in the sea, looking extremely strange.
In the middle of the red sea of ​​blood, there is a tall altar about a thousand feet high standing in the center.
The tall altar is hidden within a layer of red light curtain, looking extremely mysterious.
"Hahaha, Xiahou Zongying, you were struck by my senior brother's Wanbei palm, and you were unable to fall immediately. You were able to escape so far. I think you have reached the end of your life.
I advise you to just restrain your hands.
For the sake of past friendship, Star Ancestor might be able to let you live. "
Suddenly, a huge roar that shook the world rumbled from the tall altar deep in the blood sea.
This sound was long and far-reaching, without using any sound transmission techniques, and was only transmitted by deep magic power.
Thousands of miles away, in the golden light that was escaping from the laser, there was a middle-aged man with a pale face standing.
This man's face had no color at all, his eyes were extremely gloomy, and drops of blood were oozing from his lower lip due to clenched teeth.
But he didn't notice it at all.
At this time, he was trying hard to suppress the backlash in his body and urged Xun Guang to escape.
Hearing the words of persuasion coming from behind him, the middle-aged man didn't feel any strange at all.
This time, while Xingzu of Jiuyou Palace was out, the middle-aged man took a risk and stole two rare treasures from Jiuyou Palace. However, he was unexpectedly encountered by the inspector of Jiuyou Palace who came to patrol.
Unable to explain the reasons, he was forced to fight with several of his peers. Although he relied on secret techniques to escape from the heavily defended Jiuyou Palace, he was still wounded by Senior Brother Yan from Jiuyou Palace.
At this time, he was being chased all the way to this place.
If in his heyday, the middle-aged man would not have cared about the existence of the same level that he was chasing after him, but at this time, he was already seriously injured and could no longer be his opponent.
"Xiahou Zongying, as long as you hand over those two rare treasures, I guarantee that I will definitely plead with Mr. Xingzu to save you from death and let you suppress you under Wanyou Mountain for ten thousand years.
Otherwise, I don’t need to explain what the consequences will be. "
Seeing that the person in front showed no intention of stopping, another word of persuasion suddenly came out from the boundless sea of blood.
Just as these words came out, the golden lightning in front suddenly converged, and the middle-aged man in white suddenly stumbled out in the air. After a few hurried steps, his body swayed and stopped thousands of feet high in the sky.
At this time, his face was extremely ferocious. His teeth were deeply embedded in the flesh and blood of his lower lip due to the force of his bite, and the veins on his neck were even more exposed.
On the pale face, there was a hint of flushing at this time.
The middle-aged man in white seemed to be seriously injured, but there was a hint of madness in his eyes.
Just when the middle-aged man in white stopped, the boundless sea of ​​blood was already approaching thousands of feet away with a rumbling roar.
The continuously rolling blood-colored seawater stopped abruptly, as if encountering an invisible wall, and stopped moving any further.
"Hahaha, Xiahou Zongying, it seems that your injuries are difficult to suppress. Do you want me to do it, or do you take the initiative to hand over the two rare treasures? If I do it myself, you will have no chance of survival. You'd better think clearly about this."
As the huge sound shook the wilderness, the tall altar flashed in the middle of the sea of blood, reaching a height of thousands of meters.Zhang Zhang's altar suddenly disappeared and disappeared into the boundless sea of ​​blood.
In just a blink of an eye, a red light flashed at the edge of the blood sea, and the tall altar flashed out again.
A young monk appeared on the altar with a flash of green light.
The young man had a smile on his face and was staring at the middle-aged man in white who was thousands of feet away in front of him.
"Hmph, asking me to hand over the rare treasures is really a wishful thinking. I thought that these two treasures were originally my sister's things, but they were taken away by Jiuyou Palace.
In the end, even her life was not spared. Although I couldn't avenge Lianmei's blood, I could still explain to Lianmei by taking out her most favorite thing. "
The middle-aged man in white snorted coldly and said in a deep voice with cold eyes.
In his tone, he hated the Jiuyou Palace with all his heart.
"Haha, even if you steal them, in your current state, are you still able to keep these two things?"
